description:
What a wallet's NFTs are worth and what it holds: the estimated value
of all its NFTs in ETH and USD, the one its GONDI profile shows, with
how many it holds in its wallet, stashes and vaults and as collateral
of its loans, and its most valuable collections with their floor, count
and value. It adds the principal the wallet owes as borrower, so you can
state its net value. Answers "what is my wallet worth?" and "what NFTs
do I hold?". limit counts collections. To borrow against these NFTs,
call list_borrowing_opportunities; for the wallet's loans, call
list_borrower_loans.

wallet.description: The holder: a 0x address, a GONDI username or an ENS name (vitalik.eth).
wallet.title: Wallet

name: get_wallet_holdings

HeldCollection.description: One collection the wallet holds, its wrapped versions included.

floor_price.description: The collection's floor; null when nothing is listed.

held_count.description: The wallet's NFTs of the collection.
held_count.title: Held Count

value_eth.description: What the held NFTs are estimated to be worth, in ETH; null when nothing in the market prices any of them.
value_eth.title: Value Eth

value_usd.description: value_eth at the current ETH rate; null without either.
value_usd.title: Value Usd

HeldCollection.title: HeldCollection

amount_usd.description: At the current rate; null when the rate is unavailable.
amount_usd.title: Amount Usd

outputSchema.description: A wallet's NFTs and what they are worth, as its GONDI profile shows them.

borrowed_principal_usd.description: Principal the wallet owes on its open loans as borrower, in USD at current rates, interest excluded; null when a currency has no rate. The collateral stays in the estimate, so the estimate less this is the wallet's net NFT value.
borrowed_principal_usd.title: Borrowed Principal Usd

estimated_value_eth.description: What the wallet's NFTs are worth, in ETH: each NFT's GONDI estimate (its floor, bids, sales and traits), summed; the total the profile shows. Null when nothing in the market prices any of them.
estimated_value_eth.title: Estimated Value Eth

estimated_value_usd.description: estimated_value_eth at the current ETH rate.
estimated_value_usd.title: Estimated Value Usd

in_vault_count.description: Wrapped inside the wallet's GONDI vaults; the vault itself is an NFT in the wallet or on loan.
in_vault_count.title: In Vault Count

net_value_usd.description: estimated_value_usd less borrowed_principal_usd; null without either.
net_value_usd.title: Net Value Usd

nft_count.description: Every NFT the wallet holds, however held, as its profile counts them: a vault counts as well as each NFT it wraps, and ERC-1155 copies count once per token. The estimate leaves vaults and ERC-1155 out.
nft_count.title: Nft Count

on_loan_count.description: Locked as collateral of the wallet's open loans as borrower.
on_loan_count.title: On Loan Count

unvalued_nft_count.description: NFTs nothing in the market prices; they add nothing.
unvalued_nft_count.title: Unvalued Nft Count

valuation_truncated.description: True when the wallet holds more NFTs than GONDI values at once, leaving out the cheapest collections: the estimate is a floor.
valuation_truncated.title: Valuation Truncated

wallet_name.description: The name the address was resolved from; null when the call passed an address.
wallet_name.title: Wallet Name

outputSchema.title: WalletHoldings

title: Wallet holdings
